correctness.rationale: Exact force reduction is bijective with strictly positive equilibria. Rank-two recovery-adjusted contacts make the log potential strictly concave and coercive, giving a unique constrained maximizer. The KKT inward derivatives equal the two invasion excesses. The positive diagonal symmetrizer yields a strictly negative quadratic form by weighted Cauchy–Schwarz; admissible Euler steps yield a sign-conjugated nonnegative Jacobian and Schur stability by Perron–Frobenius. An exact rational example and seeded numerical check independently verify formulas; finite tests do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Competitive epidemic models often permit complicated equilibrium multiplicity or unstable coexistence. This structurally motivated, arbitrary-size contact class instead gives an exact two-sided invasion test and proves stability for every admissible discrete step despite completely heterogeneous strain-specific healing, sharply identifying a natural regime where bistable exclusion is impossible.
